data.body: PASS-1 review note (T1 prior-art): The plan under review proposes to *build* a three-tier plan-review replay harness (new package `src/rebar/llm/evals/plan_replay/`, frozen corpus + ledger + reports under `docs/experiments/plan-review-gate/replay/`, a new ADR, and a `docs/plan-review-gate.md` section) with commissioning spend ≤$120 — but this system already exists and is committed: the `plan_replay/` package (corpus/labels/tier0/tier1/tier2/ledger/report), the artifacts under `.../replay/` (corpus-2026-08-30.manifest.json, labels report, ledger.jsonl, tier0/1/2 reports), the $200 cap / $30 reserve in `ledger.py`, and Accepted ADR 0109 (this same epic, dated 2026-09-01) plus the tier-selection + noise-band section already in `docs/plan-review-gate.md`. The plan cites only ADR 0054 and epic 6982; it does not reference ADR 0109 or the existing implementation. Flagging as an anti-repackaging / prior-art gap for the author to reconcile (delta vs already-shipped, or restate as maintenance).
